item.title: Sangjaru at Joe's Pub
item.description: Sangjaru at Joe's PubFeb. 4. 7PM. $36 The sounds of traditional Korean music meet the instruments and rhythms of Western rock, folk, and jazz in the band Sangjaru. Based in Seoul, South Korea, the band uses instruments we all know, like the guitar, with less familiar things, like the janggu (hourglass drum) or the zither known as the kayageum, which is normally plucked but which Sangjaru often plays with a cello bow. Sangjaru plays on Feb. 4 at Joe’s Pub.

item.title: Bad Bunny, Billionaires, and the Business of Sports
item.description: More To The Story: This weekend, American football fans will be glued to their TVs to watch the New England Patriots play the Seattle Seahawks in the Super Bowl. item.title: The George Gee Swing Orchestra Meets the Arturo O'Farrill Afro-Latin Octet at Flushing Town Hall
item.description: The George Gee Swing Orchestra Meets the Arturo O'Farrill Afro-Latin Octet at Flushing Town HallFeb. 7. 7PM Dance Lessons. 8PM Performance. $25+up The George Gee Swing Orchestra started way back in 1980, bringing old-time big band music to New York listeners – and more important, to dancers.
